{{Top|leg}}
The '''Residental District''' was located on [[Estalle Island]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Procopia/Legends|Procopia]]. Each of the noble houses maintaned an official residence in [[Estalle]]. They were compact and well-appointed, and generally used for entertaining while the [[Noble/Legends|nobles]] were in town. The [[Imperial Moff's Estate]] and the [[Imperial Governor's Estate]] were located within the Residential District.<ref name="LE">''[[Lords of the Expanse]]''</ref>
